Which statement about the mass of a falling object is correct?
A
It decreases as the object falls.
B
It is equal to the weight of the object.
C
It is measured in newtons.
D
It stays the same as the object falls.

options.label: A
options.text: It decreases as the object falls.

options.label: B
options.text: It is equal to the weight of the object.

options.label: D
options.text: It stays the same as the object falls.
